2117095067743871007.en_summary: Howard Lindzon criticizes marking up AI startups 200% over the same period while Google is down 40% and Meta 30% from highs, with no moat for the product.
2117095067743871007.zh_summary: Howard Lindzon 批評在 Google 從高點下跌 40%、Meta 下跌 30% 的同時，將無護城河的 AI 初創公司估值上調 200%。

2117092550842683671.en_summary: Dylan Patel officially apologizes to Google, saying they cooked with Carbon. It is spikier in terms of domains and capabilities but really good in a few areas.
2117092550842683671.zh_summary: Dylan Patel 正式向 Google 道歉，稱他們在 Carbon 上做得很好。在領域和能力上更尖銳，但在幾個領域真的很好。

2117089055900934548.en_summary: Jason says Tucker is well sourced, Netanyahu is backed into a corner and President Trump is impulsive. If this is 90% exaggerated we should be concerned. Stopping unnecessary wars in the Middle East is the one thing DJT was elected to do.
2117089055900934548.zh_summary: Jason 稱 Tucker 消息來源可靠，Netanyahu 被逼入角落，Trump 衝動。如果這 90% 誇大，應該擔心。阻止中東不必要的戰爭是 DJT 當選的原因。

2117048012929204394.en_summary: Jason discusses that private jets do not take the same conservative approach as commercial ones, which could be the issue in today's Learjet accident. Get-there-itis is a major cause of private aviation fatalities, and he shares an anecdote about bag weight and runway length.
2117048012929204394.zh_summary: Jason 討論私人飛機不像商業飛機那樣採取保守方法，可能是今天 Learjet 事故的問題。Get-there-itis 是私人航空致命事故的主要原因，他分享了行李重量和跑道長度的輿事。

2117045059413541062.en_summary: Lyn Alden replies that she loves anti-heroes but primarily likes exploring people who make heroic decisions amid dark contexts. Transitional grittiness trending toward virtue.
2117045059413541062.zh_summary: Lyn Alden 回覆稱她喜歡反英雄，但主要喜歡探索在黑暗背景下做出英雄決定的人。過渡性的粗礞趨向美德。
